[SRS_BSW_00009]
All Basic SW Modules shall be documented according to a common
standard.

Heading
[SRS_BSW_00010]
The memory consumption of all Basic SW Modules shall be documented for
a defined configuration for all supported platforms.
[SRS_BSW_00101]
The Basic Software Module shall be able to initialize variables and hardware
in a separate initialization function
[SRS_BSW_00159]
All modules of the AUTOSAR Basic Software shall support a tool based
configuration
[SRS_BSW_00160]
Configuration files of AUTOSAR Basic SW module shall be readable for
human beings
[SRS_BSW_00161]
The AUTOSAR Basic Software shall provide a microcontroller abstraction
layer which provides a standardized interface to higher software layers
[SRS_BSW_00162]
The AUTOSAR Basic Software shall provide a hardware abstraction layer
[SRS_BSW_00164]
The Implementation of interrupt service routines shall be done by the
Operating System, complex drivers or modules
[SRS_BSW_00167]
All AUTOSAR Basic Software Modules shall provide configuration rules and
constraints to enable plausibility checks
[SRS_BSW_00168]
SW components shall be tested by a function defined in a common API in
the Basis-SW
[SRS_BSW_00170]
The AUTOSAR SW Components shall provide information about their
dependency from faults, signal qualities, driver demands
[SRS_BSW_00171]
Optional functionality of a Basic-SW component that is not required in the
ECU shall be configurable at pre-compile-time
